trex.credit: "Tyrant King - Tyrannosaurus" by Marcel Schanz (https://sketchfab.com/mschanz); textures converted/resized

raptor.credit: "PBR Velociraptor (Animated)" by Ferocious Industries (https://sketchfab.com/ferociousindustries.matthias); textures resized, animation subset
raptor.note: Scaly film-style raptor (no feathers); also usable for deinonychus at length 3.4

deinonychus.credit: "PBR Velociraptor (Animated)" by Ferocious Industries (https://sketchfab.com/ferociousindustries.matthias); textures resized, animation subset
deinonychus.note: Same mesh as raptor (generic dromaeosaur); not a Deinonychus-specific model

diplod.note: Titled Brachiosaurus but the shape (low horizontal neck, level back, whip tail; texture named 'mamenxilong') is a generic diplodocid/mamenchisaurid, so it is mapped to diplod rather than brachio

ptero.credit: "Animated Flying Pteradactal Dinosaur Loop" by LasquetiSpice (https://sketchfab.com/LasquetiSpice); textures resized
ptero.note: Pteranodon-like; scale by wingspan, not body length

allo.credit: "Allosaurus" by Alexey Zaika (https://sketchfab.com/lexazaixa25); textures converted, animation resampled
allo.note: Lower detail than the others (8k triangles), but textured and properly proportioned. 'Take 001' is a 74 s multi-action clip
